title: Everything is OK · Tonight
description: The vibe right now: counts only (world #248). Ops stay on the Everything is OK dashboard.

panels.title: The vibe
panels.description: People in the production world now (VRChat, polled every ~15 min): 0 quiet, 1–3 cozy, 4 or more lively.

panels.title: People here
panels.description: Production world occupants by instance type (VRChat's counts, polled every ~15 min).

panels.title: Rooms
panels.description: Instances of the production world (VRChat), and the tablet shards that made any request in the last hour (hourly rows). Includes the owner's own testing: the TEST world uses the same service and these counts can't tell them apart (most of 10-26's Channels plays were testing).

panels.title: Warmth, this range
panels.description: Growth of the production world's visit and favorite totals over the selected time range (VRChat's public numbers; unfavorites net out).

panels.title: Heat
panels.description: VRChat's heat for the production world (the flames on its world page), polled every ~15 min: one lit flame per point, up to 6.

panels.title: Plays by length
panels.description: Search videos played, once per room, by length, over the time range. Includes the owner's own testing: the TEST world uses the same service and these counts can't tell them apart (most of 10-26's Channels plays were testing).

panels.title: Channels and searches
panels.description: Channels: a slot opened from the Channels tab. Searches with a query, and videos played once per room, over the time range. Includes the owner's own testing: the TEST world uses the same service and these counts can't tell them apart (most of 10-26's Channels plays were testing).

panels.title: Captions and quality
panels.description: "Show captions" list loads and tracks picked on the tablet, and rooms that picked a playback quality, over the time range. Includes the owner's own testing: the TEST world uses the same service and these counts can't tell them apart (most of 10-26's Channels plays were testing).

panels.title: Here lately
panels.description: All 16 VRChat client languages; a square lights up when that language had joins in the last 2 hours (whatever the time range), from visitors who allow untrusted URLs: the bare search address the world loads once after join. It counts arrivals, not who is still here, so a square stays lit for 2 h after its last join. Dark: none; 1 join grey; 2–3 blue; 4 or more purple.

panels.title: Search languages
panels.description: The same squares for searches with a query in the last 2 hours, by VRChat client language. Includes the owner's own testing: the TEST world uses the same service and these counts can't tell them apart (most of 10-26's Channels plays were testing).

panels.title: Quest and PC
panels.description: Plays by player platform, once per room and platform, and joins that loaded the search address (untrusted URLs allowed), over the time range. Includes the owner's own testing: the TEST world uses the same service and these counts can't tell them apart (most of 10-26's Channels plays were testing).

panels.title: Through the night (Chicago time)
panels.description: Production world occupants, stacked by instance type, in America/Chicago time.

panels.title: Stayed past 03:00
panels.description: The most people in the world between 03:00 and 06:00 Chicago time (summer and winter time alike) in the last 24 h. Do people sleep here?
